title: Completed Table
description: Essential Criteria: The table must be accurately filled with correct values for Z, T_z, T, J^p, and mass excess for all isotopes.

title: IAS Quantum Numbers
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the quantum numbers J^pi, T, and T_z for the IAS in 81Kr.

title: Excitation Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the excitation energy of the IAS in 81Kr must be correct.

title: Decay Energy Estimates
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide correct estimates for the decay energies available for each decay mode listed.

title: Decay Mode Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should indicate the selection rules or factors that inhibit decay for each mode discussed.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in calculations of mass excess and decay energies.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent and correctly applied throughout the calculations.
